description.value: Tuba Café is a fully plant-based coffee shop and café in the heart of Squamish, serving an entirely vegan menu of house-made sandwiches, lentil soup, protein-packed smoothies, and desserts alongside a full espresso and tea program. Every item on the menu uses plant-based ingredients, making it a reliable stop for vegan and plant-curious cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The indoor seating creates a relaxed space to recharge after a ride.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Tuba Cafe is an active, fully plant-based café in Squamish with a detailed vegan menu (sandwiches, soups, smoothies, desserts, coffee with plant milk). OSM tags corroborate diet:vegan=only and indoor_seating=yes. One discrepancy: OSM email is contact@tubacafe.ca but the website lists tubafood.bc@gmail.com as the contact address. No bike parking, washroom, or Wi-Fi information appears on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Email mismatch: OSM lists contact@tubacafe.ca but the website displays tubafood.bc@gmail.com as the contact address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible vegan café in Squamish with a confirmed website and matching contact details. A solid stop for plant-based touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Entirely vegan menu; all listed food, drinks, and desserts are vegan

wow_evidence: fully plant-based coffee shop and café in the heart of Squamish
